analysis.estimand: Two-implementation agreement check on the SAME trace/seed/config differing only in execution.compute_delay_s. Gate evidence: every uncovered interval ('gap') in each delivered packet's timeline equals compute_delay_s exactly (per gap, not merely in sum), and the independent per-link utilisation / per-packet phase recomputation closes against the production reading with zero unexplained mismatches. The declared primary metric e2e_delay_mean_s is the quantity both implementations compute, so it is the natural meeting point for the second opinion; it is reported descriptively and is NOT an effect-size, superiority, causal or performance claim. Note explicitly: the aggregate difference in e2e delay between the two arms is NOT required to equal (decisions x compute_delay_s), because a non-zero compute delay legitimately changes event ordering and therefore the other phases.
